name: @seen/core
description: Deterministic reconciliation: matching, fee expectations and euro arithmetic as pure functions.
//test: test is the whole suite and is what `turbo run test` and therefore CI runs: the pure
functions under src/ and the schema, tenancy, privilege and uniqueness tests under db/.
The db half needs the local Supabase stack with the migrations applied, which CI has up
before it runs the tests and a developer gets from `pnpm dev:up` and `pnpm db:reset`.
test:unit is the database-free path, for a machine with no stack running; test:db is the
db half on its own. Neither is a substitute for test: a tenancy guard that only runs when
somebody types the filter command by hand guards nothing.
